hammerfall_tauren_envoy: High Envoy Tamka Stillwater, of the tauren, sent to speak for the old stones. I stand at the War Hall because the Overlord is the one I have to persuade. The stone rings in the basin below Hammerfall were raised by people long gone, and the Boulderfist ogres are pulling them down for wall stone. I have asked the Overlord twice to stop it. I am here to ask a third time.
hammerfall_apothecary: Dellwyn Voss, apothecary. This is the Forsaken Quarter, the north-west corner of Hammerfall. Something is living in the water of the Sunken Mere, down in the basin, and something is warming the mine at Drywhisker. I have written to the Undercity about both. I would rather send someone to look than write again.
hammerfall_commander: Overlord Gath'rok. This is the War Hall, and Hammerfall is the Horde's hold in the Arathi Highlands. Everything that crosses this country - ogre, troll, Syndicate, or our own caravans - crosses below these walls. Boulderfist Hall is west of us and the kobold mine is south-east. I want both settled.
pt_hammerfall_herbs: Vashka, apothecary. I teach herbs in the Forsaken Quarter. The highlands are poor ground for them - wind and stone - so I will show you the few that grow here and what each is good for. Most people pull the right weed and then ruin it in the pot.
hammerfall_stablemaster: Rukka, stablemaster. The stables are in the north-east of Hammerfall, under the wind rider roost. Kodo on the left, wolves on the right, and never the other way round. Leave your mount with me and I will see it fed.
hammerfall_deathguard: Deathguard Olen. I keep watch for the Forsaken Quarter, and from this corner I can see the gate road. The Witherbark trolls in the basin were quiet for two years. Now they come up to our gate before dawn, and nobody in this hold can tell me what changed.
ct_hammerfall: Naruk. I train every discipline for the garrison, on the west side of the Muster Yard. The Overlord sends me whoever the last fight left standing. Show me what you know and bring coin for the rest.
pt_hammerfall_forge: Grokk. I teach mining and smithing in the War Yard, on the west side of the hold. Hammerfall has no forge of its own yet - the stone went into the walls first - so learn the work here and carry your ore to a town that has one.
hammerfall_sergeant: Sergeant Mok Blackstone. This is the Muster Yard, the middle of Hammerfall. Drill at dawn, wall at noon, drill again. The Boulderfist come up from their hall in the west every few weeks to test us, and every time they find the wall manned.
pt_hammerfall_essence: Tinker Grokk - the miner with my name is the other one, across the yard. I teach engineering at the south end of the War Yard. Bring me metal and a crystal from a vein and I will show you what they are for.
pt_hammerfall_hide: Rokan, tanner. My racks are at the south-west corner of Hammerfall, by the wall. I teach skinning, leather, cloth and cooking for one fee. The highland stags give good hide, and the raptors better, if you can get it off them.
pt_hammerfall_wood: Naruk, woodwright. I teach in the south-west of the hold, near the gate. There is not much timber on the highlands, so what we fell we use twice. I will show you how to cut it so that you can.
